generation_review.prompt:
Draw exactly ONE new Small Seal font glyph from the attached reference image. It shows FOUR historical specimen slots of the SAME character labelled THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC; any slot marked UNAVAILABLE is absent evidence. Study ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally. Reconstruct one coherent attested whole form with the original ancient identity; do not combine incompatible variant components, imitate only THX, or substitute a modern Chinese character.

Build genuine smooth stroke trajectories as original harmonious Gothic monoline drawing, with absolutely CONSTANT stroke width around 3% of the full canvas. All strokes must share that width, with round caps and round joins, smooth rounded curves and precise straight bars, no taper, swelling, brush outlines, serifs, pressure modulation, textures or blobs. Keep every required counter and gap clearly open. Essential bar length relationships, branches, descending legs, tiny detached marks and contacts are structural requirements, not decoration.

Use a square 1:1 canvas. Center the ONE glyph inside the central70% with generous clear margins. Output ONLY pure BLACK constant-width strokes on a fully TRANSPARENT background, with no labels, text, codepoint, chart, grid, background, frame, shadows, watermark or multiple specimens. Exactly one complete glyph.

Explicit structural/proportion reading aid:
U+3D07A is a VERTICALLY STACKED glyph, not left/right radicals. Choose coherent THX/DYC whole form with a CLEAR GAP between upper and lower components (CCZ/QJZ connected forms are different variants). UPPER component: one central vertical stem rises a little ABOVE a wide STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL top bar. Immediately below that bar, TWO small detached roof-shaped chevrons (∧) lie left/right of the stem, one per side. Each chevron consists of two short diagonals meeting at an upward apex; all four chevron ends remain free. Lower in upper component, a broad INVERTED-U/umbrella arch curves from left lower tip up to meet the center stem, then down to right lower tip. The center stem continues down inside that arch to approximately the arch-tip height. Exactly THREE downward ends here (left arch leg, center stem, right arch leg), with no horizontal closing line. BELOW with clear gap is a separate 王-like stem joining THREE parallel horizontal bars. Top and middle lower bars about EQUAL length; bottom bar modestly LONGER (about110–115% of top), not shorter. Lower base width about same or slightly wider than upper top bar. Upper component around60% of full glyph height, lower around30%, gap clear. NO enclosed counters anywhere. Preserve two detached chevrons, upper three-ended umbrella and all three lower bars.

visual_review.method: white inspection composite compared against all available reference specimens
reading_criteria: Vertically stacked THX/DYC-type form with clear gap between upper tree/umbrella and lower three-bar stem.
Upper wide bar, tall central stub, two detached roof chevrons and broad arch with three lower ends.
Lower top/middle bars comparable; bottom longest; no enclosed counters.
notes: All four references and enlarged forms compared. Native preserves chosen detached whole form, both chevrons, three upper downward ends and lower three-bar base.
Lower bottom bar longer than top/middle; all gaps open.
caveats: CCZ/QJZ join upper stem into lower bars as different whole variants; native follows THX/DYC separation.

visual_reference_review.reviewer: independent visual structural review by stroke_font_engine
notes: All four references compared. Accepted detached stacked THX/DYC whole construction: upper horizontal and projecting stem, two detached free chevrons, and a connected three-ended lower umbrella.
A clear gap separates that upper figure from a lower three-horizontal/vertical component; CCZ/QJZ joined alternatives are not mixed into the native. No counters.
Lower baseline is longest and middle bar is shorter; both chevrons retain two distinct diagonal legs and their detachments from the center stem.
limitations: Visual comparison against the supplied chart raster; not specialist paleographic certification.
Does not verify historical writing order, exact metrics, or final font stroke width.
Verdict applies only to the source PNG hash recorded here.
